stages.title: CONTEMPORARY-ANCHOR DISCIPLINE
stages.terms: Contemporary-anchor discipline: ⚠️ Inference: Use anekāntavāda as a conceptual resource for intellectual humility and sallekhanā as a bounded ethics application.
stages.mechanism: ⚠️ Inference: Use anekāntavāda as a conceptual resource for intellectual humility and sallekhanā as a bounded ethics application.
stages.consequence: Do not invent a fresh legal development or let current application replace the printed metaphysics–logic–liberation syllabus.
stages.trap: ✅ Fact: A live August 2026 search primarily returned contemporary educational discussion of anekāntavāda and continuing ethical discussion of sallekhanā, not a clearly verified new court ruling in the February–August window.

stages.title: MASTER DISTINCTION GATEWAY
stages.terms: Master verdict: Jainism is pluralistic realism with epistemic non-absolutism and a material theory of karmic bondage; its unity lies in linking ontology, knowledge, conduct and liberation.
stages.mechanism: Reality contains many genuine aspects; finite knowers see only some of them; statements must therefore be qualified; and right knowledge must transform conduct so that karmic bondage can end.
stages.consequence: Reality contains many genuine aspects; finite knowers see only some of them; statements must therefore be qualified; and right knowledge must transform conduct so that karmic bondage can end.
stages.trap: A live 2026 search found contemporary discussion of anekāntavāda and sallekhanā, used only as labelled conceptual application rather than doctrinal authority.
stages.answer: Recommended opening definition: Jainism (Jina-centred path of many-sided reality and liberation) is a pluralist realism in which anekāntavāda (doctrine of many-sided reality) holds that enduring dravya (substance) possesses guṇa (qualities) and changing paryāya (modes).
